exercises.instruction: Match the weather words on the left with the sentences on the right.
items: a You can't see it but it makes things move about.
b It makes a very loud noise.
c When light comes suddenly from the sky, often during a storm.
d It's yellow and makes you feel warm.
e Water falling from the sky.
f These are sometimes big and white and can be seen in the sky.
g It's a very strong wind.
i It's a strong wind and heavy rain together.
j You can't see things in the distance.

exercises.instruction: If the adjective form ends in 'y', write it in the box. If it does not, put an X in the box.

items: 1 Yesterday was a sunshine day, but today it's cloudy.
2 It's snowing in New York and fogging in Chicago today.
3 It's very wet in the Sahara Desert. It hardly ever rains there.
4 We had a stormthunder last night. It woke me up.
5 It was raining and winding, so we stayed at home.
